title: PAHUNCHE YEH NAZM YOON SHAHE ZEESHAAN KE SAAMNE
body:
PAHUNCHE YEH NAZM YOON SHAHE ZEESHAAN KE SAAMNE
JIS TARHA PAAYE MORE SULEMAAN KE SAAMNE
<<DIVIDER>>
HAR DUM SAKINA LAATHI THI TASKEEN KE WAASTEY
KHAALI KATORAY ASGHARE NAADAAN KE SAAMNE
<<DIVIDER>>
ROKAR BEHEN SE KEHTEY THAY HAZRAT YEH ROZEY QATL
HUM ZIBHA HONGAY ASR KO AMMA KE SAAMNE
<<DIVIDER>>
ZIBHE HILAAL MEIN TOH YEH HUKME-RASOOL HO
HAIWAAN KA KHOON BAHAO NA HAIWAAN KE SAAMNE
<<DIVIDER>>
WA HASRATHA KE FATEMA SAR PEET THI RAHI
PYAASE HUSSAIN ZIBHA HUVE MAA KE SAAMNE
<<DIVIDER>>
RAKHLEY UTHAKEY SAR PAH ADAB SEY YEH CHAHIYEH
MOUSUF JAB AAYE SAAHEBE IMAAN KE SAAMNE
<<DIVIDER>>
NEECHEY SAREY HUSSAIN HO AUR TAQTH PAR YAZEED
PHAILAAYE PAOUN BAITHA HO QURAAN KE SAAMNE
<<DIVIDER>>
KHOOLI SE SHIMR KEHTA THA LEY JAH SAR-E-HUSSAIN
RAKH KAR SINAA PAH ZAINABE ZEESHAAN KE SAAMNE
